observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel gas cooktop with five burners: three on the front row and two on the back row, with black grates and control knobs below.
Photo 1 shows the front panel with the brand name 'MAXI' visible, six black control knobs, and an open oven with two metal racks inside.
The oven door is open, revealing a black interior with a glass window on the door.
The cooktop surface appears clean but shows minor scratches and wear.
The oven racks are metal and appear to be in good condition.
The overall unit is a freestanding gas cooker with an integrated oven and grill.
